data.name: The Fifth Notice
data.description: Nyra Shinkai said nothing when you found her. She pressed a folded page into your hands and pointed the way. Deliver it to the Global ANBU headquarters in Sector 222, then pick up the next quest, The Nameless Thorn, from the Global ANBU quest board.
data.successDescription: The clerk reads the page twice and goes very quiet. PICK UP THE NEXT QUEST: open the Global ANBU building's quest board and accept The Nameless Thorn. Her file is open.

objectives.description: Deliver her page to the Global ANBU headquarters in Sector 222. When you arrive, ENTER the Global ANBU building and open its quest board.
objectives.successDescription: You are at the Global ANBU. Enter the building and open the quest board: the file called The Nameless Thorn is waiting for you there.

objectives.description: NEXT STEP: open the Global ANBU building here in Sector 222 and accept the quest The Nameless Thorn from its board. Her file is open, and it only opens once.

data.name: The Last Shadow
data.description: A co-op story for three level-100 shinobi. Pursue Raizen Kurogane from Blackstone Fortress to the Valley of Echoes, uncover a failing ancient seal, and hold the line against the Shadow Beast.
data.successDescription: Your squad uncovers the truth behind Raizen's escape and seals the Shadow Beast beneath the Valley of Echoes. Raizen returns to custody. The public record names a captured fugitive; the classified report remembers the man who saved the world.

objectives.description: Commander Kael studies a dispatch. "Raizen Kurogane has escaped Blackstone Detention Fortress. Every nation calls him the world's most dangerous criminal. I need a three-person squad to follow his trail. Stay together, and find out what he is running toward before we lose him."

nextObjectiveId.text: Our three-person squad will join the pursuit.

objectives.description: Investigate Blackstone Detention Fortress for evidence of Raizen's escape.
objectives.successDescription: Broken sealing chains and destroyed prison barriers reveal a carefully planned escape rather than a reckless breakout.

objectives.description: The cell restraints were severed cleanly. Most of the fortress's ward network remains intact, and no prison staff were killed. Whoever left knew exactly which seals to break.
Follow Raizen's trail to the abandoned watchtower on the frozen border.
objectives.successDescription: Abandoned supplies and tracks in the snow suggest Raizen kept moving while avoiding unnecessary conflict.

objectives.description: Four mercenaries emerge from the frozen watchtower, weapons drawn. Your squad closes ranks as they block the trail. Kael signals from the ridge: hold the tower and break their ambush.
Four rogue mercenaries surround the frozen watchtower. They intend to collect Raizen's bounty and silence your three-person ANBU squad. Break the ambush together.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends without containment.
objectives.failDescription: Your formation breaks beneath the enemy assault.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat before the objective is secured.
objectives.successDescription: The surviving mercenaries surrender. Their leader spits into the snow. "He disarmed us and left us breathing. Could have killed every one of us. Whatever he wants, it isn't a body count."

objectives.description: Commander Kael: “He could have slaughtered every squad we've sent. Instead, he leaves them alive. Either he's mocking us… or he's trying to save time.”

nextObjectiveId.text: Then we reach the valley before time runs out.

objectives.description: System Narration: “Your hesitation costs the pursuit its only remaining lead. Far beneath the Valley of Echoes, the first ancient chain breaks.”
The mercenaries scatter the pursuit. Regroup at the Frozen Borderlands and intercept them again.
Continue pursuing Raizen toward the Valley of Echoes.
objectives.successDescription: Raizen stands before an ancient shrine surrounded by enormous sealing chains.

objectives.description: Raizen stands beneath the shrine's failing chains. "Blackstone is an anchor in a sealing network. The prison kept me from reaching this shrine, and its wards helped hold the creature beneath it. The network was failing before I escaped. I broke only the restraints I had to. Now let me reach the array before the last chain snaps."

nextObjectiveId.text: Keep him under guard, but let him reach the array.
Attack Raizen despite his warning (fails the quest).

objectives.description: System Narration: “The ancient sealing chains begin breaking apart as black chakra erupts from beneath the shrine.”
Commander Kael: “Change of mission. Raizen is no longer the target. Everyone prepare for containment!”
Hold the shrine against the awakened Shadow Beast. Your three-person squad draws its attacks while Kael's ANBU secure the perimeter and Raizen gathers the broken chains.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends without containment.
objectives.failDescription: Your formation breaks beneath the enemy assault.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat before the objective is secured.
objectives.successDescription: The beast's manifested body collapses, but the fissure still leaks black chakra. Raizen drags the broken chains back to the central array. The creature is already rebuilding itself.

objectives.description: Raizen grips a chain with shaking hands. "I heard the network weakening through the prison wards. My warnings never left my cell. I did not escape to save myself. Keep that thing off me, and I can still close the breach."

nextObjectiveId.text: Then we finish what you started.

objectives.description: System Narration: “Raizen falls before he can reach the seal. The shrine splits open, and living darkness pours into the valley.”
The first containment line collapses. Regroup with Commander Kael and defend the shrine again.
Move to Raizen's ritual position beside the Valley of Echoes shrine. Brace the restored chain anchors while he rebuilds the central seal.
objectives.successDescription: The chains reconnect around the fissure. As Raizen channels chakra into the last anchor, the Shadow Beast claws its way back into form. Your squad must hold it until the seal closes.

objectives.description: The chain anchors settle into place. Raizen kneels at the restored array as the Shadow Beast reforms over the fissure. Your squad takes position between the creature and the final anchor.
The Shadow Beast regenerates beside the ritual. All three squad members must defeat its manifested body while Raizen closes the seal.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends without containment.
objectives.failDescription: Your formation breaks beneath the enemy assault.
objectives.fleeDescription: You retreat before the objective is secured.
objectives.successDescription: The ancient seal reforms, imprisoning the Shadow Beast once more beneath the valley.

objectives.description: Kael turns to Raizen as the last chain locks into place. "The world still knows you as an escaped convict. The truth will stay in a sealed report, but every operative here knows who held those chains."
Raizen lowers his hands. "Sometimes saving the world means letting it hate you first." He offers his wrists to Kael. This time, the restraints carry no sealing script.
Return with your squad, Commander Kael, and Raizen to Global ANBU Command.
objectives.successDescription: The official report is rewritten under the highest classification level.

objectives.description: Commander Kael: “This operation will remain classified. Officially, we captured a fugitive. Unofficially… we survived because of him.”
System Narration: “The mission is sealed under the codename: The Last Shadow.”
Commander Kael: “Remember this lesson. Not every fugitive is running from justice. Sometimes… they're running toward it.”
The final seal fractures. Fall back to Raizen's ritual position and attempt containment again.
The beast is sealed, Raizen returns to custody, and your squad's testimony is preserved in a classified report. Only those who stood at the shrine know the truth behind The Last Shadow.

data.name: The Long Road
data.description: A merchant needs an escort for a cart of trade goods on the long road between waystations. The quiet stretches are the dangerous ones.
data.successDescription: Cart delivered whole. The merchant pays gladly.

objectives.description:
The merchant checks the cart straps for the third time.

"It's one long road and two quiet stretches, they say.
The quiet is what worries me.
Walk with the cart and keep your hands free."
Escort the cart along the first stretch of the long road.

The second stretch.
Birdsong stops.
A lone figure steps out of the treeline ahead of the cart, weapon already drawn.
The merchant goes very pale behind you.
Drive off the ambusher and protect the cart.
objectives.drawDescription: Neither side yielded. The contract stands.
objectives.failDescription: They were stronger than the posting suggested. Regroup.

objectives.description: The ambusher forced you back and the merchant fled to the last waystation with the cart. Regroup and walk the road again.
The ambusher limps into the trees and the cart rolls into the waystation whole. The merchant counts out your pay twice, to be sure.

data.name: The Lost Sky Maiden
data.description: Fujin's revered priestess, the Sky Maiden Ayame, has vanished from Akikaze's highest sanctuaries after false chime omens and broken oracle kites disturbed the temples. Investigate Ayame's last movements, expose the false summons, and rescue the Sky Maiden before spiritual trust collapses.
data.successDescription: You have found Sky Maiden Ayame, exposed the false omens used to lure her from the sanctuaries, and restored trust in Fujin's sacred rites. Akikaze's chimes ring clear once more, and the village remembers that faith must flow with wisdom, not fear.

objectives.description: Elder Shion: Sky Maiden Ayame is missing. A false divine summons was rung, and someone has taught the temple chimes to lie. Find her before the sanctuaries lose faith.
Search Sky Maiden Ayame's shrine for signs of tampering.
objectives.successDescription: Scattered prayer beads and Ayame's cracked personal chime suggest she was lured away by a false summons.

objectives.description: Novice Priest Ren: Lady Ayame heard the summons after moonrise and followed it toward the terraces. She carried her prayer beads, white mantle, and the Pure Chime Core.
Councilor Iroha: This chime was over-vibrated with an artificial pressure seal. Someone faked Fujin's summons by bullying physics into committing blasphemy.
Follow Ayame's scattered prayer beads to the Oracle Kite Terrace.
objectives.successDescription: Torn oracle kites bear altered ritual markings linked to a false omen seal.

objectives.description: Defeat the false chime apparitions created by the corrupted oracle tools.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.successDescription: A torn oracle silk fragment reveals a false omen seal.

objectives.description: Saeji of the Sky Wardens: This was not random. The culprit knew temple rites well enough to lure Ayame with something made to sound like Fujin.
Investigate the Chime Archive for copied summons patterns.
objectives.successDescription: High-summons records have been accessed, and several archive chimes sway out of rhythm.

objectives.description: Elder Shion: The false summons copied an old training pattern. The name beside it is Kazane, a former acolyte expelled from sanctuary service.
Elder Shion: Kazane believed the priesthood should command the Council. When Ayame became Sky Maiden, Kazane called it surrender to politics and vanished.
Track Cloud-Reed Pollen from the archive toward the Cloud-Reed Garden.
objectives.successDescription: Bent reeds reveal hidden footsteps through the otherwise peaceful garden.

objectives.description: Defeat Kazane's veiled acolytes hiding among the cloud-reeds.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.successDescription: One acolyte drops a Pilgrim's Vision Tablet pointing toward Pilgrim's Hollow.

objectives.description: Enter Pilgrim's Hollow and search for signs of Ayame.
objectives.successDescription: Ayame's prayer beads and a warm Sanctuary Binding Ribbon are found near an old vision altar.

objectives.description: System Narration: The vision tablet warns that false wind demands obedience, while true wind moves through resistance. The Pure Chime Core may be able to break Kazane's illusions.
Follow the binding ribbon's chakra trail to Broken Kite Ravine.
objectives.successDescription: Broken oracle kite frames have been turned into aerial traps.

objectives.description: Defeat the kite-bound ambushers guarding the route to the Eye of Fujin.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.successDescription: The ravine winds clear, revealing a rising current toward the Eye of Fujin.

objectives.description: Ride the rising current to the Eye of Fujin.
objectives.successDescription: Ayame is bound in corrupted prayer ribbons while Kazane holds the Pure Chime Core before the sacred updraft.

objectives.description: Kazane the False Wind: Ayame wastes Fujin's breath on compromise. I will give Akikaze a priesthood that commands, not advises.

nextObjectiveId.text: Fujin's wind guides. It does not chain.
You used false omens to kidnap a priestess.
Maybe Akikaze needs stronger spiritual rule.

objectives.description: Defeat Kazane before she forces Ayame to consecrate the false summons.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.successDescription: Kazane falls, but the corrupted Pure Chime Core continues distorting the sacred chamber.

objectives.description: Sky Maiden Ayame: Steady the chime core. Let it remember itself. The true wind does not need to be dragged into song.

nextObjectiveId.text: Ring the chime core gently with steady chakra.
Force Ayame to cleanse it immediately.

objectives.description: System Narration: Your decision strengthens the false omen or delays Ayame's rescue. Kazane escapes into the upper winds, and Sky Maiden Ayame remains missing as Akikaze's temples fall silent.
Sky Maiden Ayame is safe, the false chime devices are exposed, and Akikaze's sanctuaries ring with true wind again.

data.name: The Lost Wind
data.description: One of Akikaze's primary wind currents has vanished without warning, cutting power to nearly thirty percent of the village. Investigate the missing current, trace the disruption through Akikaze's turbine network, and restore the lost wind before the blackout spreads.
data.successDescription: You have restored the missing wind current, stabilized the main power station, and uncovered the hidden cause behind the disruption.

objectives.description: Councilor Iroha - Main Power Station: Thirty percent of the village has lost power because one of our primary wind currents has vanished. Winds do not simply disappear. Help me find out what happened.
Toma the Turbine Keeper - Main Power Station: The western turbines lost the current instantly. It was not a gradual failure, it was as if the wind itself was sealed away.
Investigate the damaged western turbine array and determine what happened to the missing current. Location: Main Power Station.
objectives.successDescription: You discover a Dead Current Gauge and evidence that the airflow was abruptly cut off by an artificial force.

objectives.description: Follow the pressure residue through the Turbine Spine Walkway. Location: Turbine Spine Walkway.
objectives.successDescription: Unstable pressure has thrown maintenance drones into chaos.

objectives.description: Defeat the malfunctioning maintenance drones before they destroy the turbine network.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent.
objectives.successDescription: You recover a Pressure Residue Sample while Saeji secures the walkway.

objectives.description: Saeji of the Sky Wardens - Turbine Spine Walkway: This was not sabotage in the usual sense. Something pulled the wind away from these ducts instead of damaging them.
Bring the Pressure Residue Sample to the Chime Calibration Hall for analysis. Location: Chime Calibration Hall.
objectives.successDescription: Elder Shion reveals the missing current has been spiritually silenced rather than destroyed.

objectives.description: Elder Shion - Chime Calibration Hall: The current cannot answer the chime because it has been wrapped in stillness. Take the Silent Chime Core, it will guide you back to the lost wind.
Follow the Silent Chime Core into the Hollow Draft Tunnel. Location: Hollow Draft Tunnel.
objectives.successDescription: The tunnel is unnaturally silent, and the Silent Chime Core begins reacting.

objectives.description: Defeat the Windless Shades formed from dead air pockets.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent.
objectives.successDescription: The Silent Chime Core points toward Fujin's Listening Shrine.

objectives.description: Investigate Fujin's Listening Shrine. Location: Fujin's Listening Shrine.
objectives.successDescription: Mira describes the suffering caused by the blackout while Elder Shion prepares a ritual to locate the missing current.

objectives.description: Elder Shion - Fujin's Listening Shrine: Place the Silent Chime Core near the shrine. The remaining breath of the current will reveal where it has been imprisoned.

nextObjectiveId.text: Use the Pressure Residue Sample with the core.
Force wind chakra into the shrine.

objectives.description: Follow the revealed path into the hidden chamber known as the Windless Eye. Location: The Windless Eye.
objectives.successDescription: A trapped vortex of compressed wind surrounds an ancient pressure seal.

objectives.description: Councilor Iroha - The Windless Eye: That ancient pressure seal has been feeding on the current for years. Whatever is inside is no longer just a seal, it has become something far worse.
Defeat the Stillness Wraith without destroying the trapped wind current.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw.
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent.
objectives.successDescription: You recover the Recovered Wind Core and destroy the ancient pressure seal.

objectives.description: System Narration - The Windless Eye: The current is free but unstable. Guide it safely back to the power station before it overloads the turbines.
Escort the restored current back through the turbine network to the Main Power Station. Location: Main Power Station.
objectives.successDescription: The western turbines begin turning once more as engineers prepare for reintegration.

objectives.description: Toma the Turbine Keeper - Main Power Station: Pressure is stabilizing. The turbines are turning again. The current has finally come home.
Councilor Iroha - Main Power Station: Power has returned across Akikaze. The damage is manageable, but someone or something left an ancient wind trap beneath my mountain. I intend to find out why.
Elder Shion - Main Power Station: The lost wind has returned, but the broken seal is a warning. Old forces still linger beneath Akikaze, waiting to be heard once more.
objectives.successDescription: Quest complete.

objectives.description: System Narration: Your actions destabilize the missing current or delay its recovery. The power station enters emergency shutdown, leaving large sections of Akikaze without power as the Council seals the damaged wind routes.
objectives.successDescription: The quest ends in failure.

data.name: The Misfiled Board
data.description: A week of contracts went up on the wrong boards. The clerk would rather die than admit it. Fix it quietly.
data.successDescription: Boards corrected. Nobody has to know.

objectives.description:
The clerk speaks without looking up, very quietly.

"A week of postings went to the wrong boards. If you collect the misplaced ones and repin them on the correct ones."
"This conversation never happened."
Collect the misplaced postings from around the village.
Repin the postings at the annex board.
Every posting hangs where it should. The clerk slides a completed contract across the counter without a word.

data.name: The Nameless Thorn
data.description: Nyra Shinkai took your wrists and gave you her memory of the four people she saved. Walk it the way she walked it, and you will know where she has gone.
data.successDescription: You walked her road to the place where it began, and she let you go owing nothing. Carry the sky.

objectives.description:
Rain falls from the sky in large droplets as a woman with one black hand and one violet hand watches you, the way a storm watches a field.

"People come for the Reckoning with a list of names," she says.
"Do you want to understand them first? Give me your hands."

Her grip is cold at first but then it's not, the rain you're standing in seems to change and become a different type of rain.
The storm did not break over the ruins of Seichi; it bled into them.

High in the crags, the cult called the "Unbroken Thread" raised two orphaned sisters as a key and not as daughters: "Eclipse", whose chakra pooled black and light-devouring, and Aegis, who heard a dying god in the thunder.

On the eve of their nineteenth winter the Thread bound them to stone and siphoned their blood into old machines; but the sisters broke the ritual, brought the mountain down, and died of poisoned needles in a muddy ditch beside an abandoned road.

A scavenger girl of sixteen knelt in the mud, gave them the last of her water, and covered them with her only blanket.
Eclipse took her right wrist and Aegis took her left.
"Live for us."
"Carry the sky."

After years of travelling along on the roads of Seichi, eventually it leads to a bridge.

Under it a man is bleeding from an execution he escaped, and on the road above the patrols are calling to each other.

"His name is Kaizen Arakuro, and he cannot run."

nextObjectiveId.text: Keep walking. This is not your road.
Pull him into the dark under the bridge and hide him.
Go up and meet the patrol with a blade.

objectives.description:
The memory seizes around your wrists.
That is not what she did.

The memory refuses that shape. Someone once knelt in the mud for her, and whatever she did under that bridge, it was not walk on and it was not draw a blade.
The memory refuses that shape. Someone once knelt in the mud for her, and whatever she did under that bridge, it was not walk on and it was not draw a blade.

The patrol passes.
When the road is quiet Kaizen asks her why, but she doesn't even have to think about it.

Months later; Mira Kagetsu stands in the middle of a scorched field with three hunters dead at her feet and seven more closing in.
She hasn't asked anyone for anything.

nextObjectiveId.text: Wait at the treeline for it to end.
Circle behind the hunters and take them one at a time.

objectives.description:
The memory seizes around your wrists.
That is not what she did.

The memory refuses that shape. She has never waited at the edge of someone else's fight, and she has never come at one sideways.
The memory refuses that shape. She has never waited at the edge of someone else's fight, and she has never come at one sideways.

The sky turns violet.
She walks, and the hunters turn from Mira to look at what is coming across the field toward them.
Three Thorn Bounty Hunters break from the ring around Mira and come for you under a violet sky.
objectives.drawDescription: The thunder stops with no one standing over anyone. The memory waits.
objectives.failDescription: The hunters close the ring again. The memory holds its breath and waits for you to try once more.
objectives.fleeDescription: You leave the field. She never did, and the memory waits.
objectives.successDescription: By the time the thunder stops, the surviving hunters have fled.

objectives.description: The field resets under the violet sky. Mira is still standing, and so are the hunters.

Mira stares at the strange girl standing among the scorched earth.
"I didn't need saving." she says.

nextObjectiveId.text: Good. Then you owe me nothing.

objectives.description:
Mira followed her anyway.
Daigo Muren was harder: the Hollow Hound is hunting an official that's tied to the prisoner experiments, and he has walked straight into a trap, with enough shinobi sent by his former village to make sure he finally disappears.

nextObjectiveId.text: He asked for no help. Let him handle it.
Shout a warning and stay out of it.

objectives.description:
The memory seizes around your wrists.
That is not what she did.

The memory refuses that shape, and it takes you further back for it. She has never let someone disappear because they were too proud to ask.
The memory refuses that shape, and it takes you further back for it. She has never let someone disappear because they were too proud to ask.

The ambush closes the road.
The Thorn Ambush Captain holds the line while his ambushers draw, and none of them are looking at Daigo anymore.
The Thorn Ambush Captain and two Thorn Ambushers turn from Daigo to you.
objectives.drawDescription: Nobody holds the road. The memory waits.
objectives.failDescription: The road closes over you. The memory waits for you to try again.
objectives.fleeDescription: You leave the road. She never did, and the memory waits.
objectives.successDescription: The ambush breaks. Daigo is down but breathing, and already furious.

objectives.description: The road resets. The captain is back on his line, and Daigo is back in the trap.

Daigo wakes beside a campfire, furious that anyone interfered.
Kaizen laughs, Mira tells him he complains too much, and she picks up his weapon.

nextObjectiveId.text: Tell him he owes you his life.
Hand him his weapon. You can leave.

objectives.description:
He stayed and looked around the fire.
Then came Sorin Vey, the Ashen Saint, found in the ashes of his own quarantine district with a vial at his neck and the poison already spreading, because he had come back there to die.
She knows that look because she's seen it before.
She saw it in Eclipse, and she saw it in Aegis.

nextObjectiveId.text: Argue until he agrees to treatment.
Respect his choice. It is his to make.

objectives.description:
The memory seizes around your wrists.
That is not what she did.

The memory refuses that shape, and it takes you further back for it. Someone who has decided there will be no tomorrow is not asking permission, and she learned that in a ditch.
The memory refuses that shape, and it takes you further back for it. Someone who has decided there will be no tomorrow is not asking permission, and she learned that in a ditch.

When he wakes the poison is gone and four strangers are sitting nearby.
"You had no right.." Sorin whispers.

"Then.. why..?"

For a moment she hears the rain, and remembers two dying women in a muddy ditch.

nextObjectiveId.text: Because we keep finding each other.

objectives.description:
Years later, beneath an abandoned shrine, Kaizen lays their broken village plates on the altar.
Mira wants pain, Daigo demands confession, Sorin answers consequences.

Then Kaizen looks at her and asks what she wants.

nextObjectiveId.text: For them to be afraid of being forgotten.

objectives.description:
The memory seizes around your wrists.
That is not what she did.

The memory refuses that shape, and it takes everything back. Those were their wants, and you were listening to the wrong person; it starts again at the bridge.
The memory refuses that shape, and it takes everything back. Those were their wants, and you were listening to the wrong person; it starts again at the bridge.

The memory lets go of your wrists, and she is gone.
The rain is only rain again.

In your hands, folded once, there is a page, her ink still bleeding in the wet.

The handwriting is small and unhurried.

"You walked it the way I walked it.
Whatever you came to collect, you already have it, and you owe me nothing.

A name does nothing, and people die for those anyway.
If anyone ever asks whether the Thorn was a person, you were there. Tell them what you saw."

There is no signature. There is a thorn, drawn in one stroke, ink-black down one side.

Beyond the clouds the storm rumbles once and moves on.
Nyra Shinkai remembered every name, and now one of them is yours.

data.name: The Path of a Shinobi
data.description:
"The Mortal King," Haki begins, his voice echoing in the stillness, "is no mere legend.
He is a celestial being whose presence alone disturbs the balance of our world.
He walks the line between divinity and mortality, wielding powers that can reshape the very fabric of Seichi."

He gestures toward a map spread across the table.
Marked upon it are several locations where traces of the Mortal King's presence have been detected—places where the laws of nature have been twisted, and chaos has ensued.
Wildfire erupts in the Shining Dunes without cause; eternal storms rage in Akikaze's Whirling Valley; ice forms in Hyorin's Frozen Highlands, not of Kuraokami's making, but of something far more sinister.

"Your mission is to track these disturbances," Haki continues, his eyes locking onto each Chunin in turn.
"Investigate the traces left behind by this celestial figure.
Find out what he seeks, and most importantly, prevent him from reaching the Monarch Powers—ancient forces that, if combined with his celestial abilities, could plunge our world into irreversible darkness."

The Chunin exchange glances, their resolve hardening.
Each of them carries the weight of their village on their shoulders, but none falter.
They understand the stakes—failure is not an option.

Haki pauses, allowing the gravity of his words to sink in.
Then, with a final nod, he concludes, "You will face not just the Mortal King, but those who serve him—beings of great power and deception.
Trust in your training, in each other, and in Seichi.
Dismissed."
data.successDescription:
They have won, but the victory is bittersweet.
Haki, once their leader, now lies defeated and broken.
The Monarch Powers remain beyond their reach, but Seichi is safe—for now.

As they make their way back to the surface, the Chunin know that their journey is far from over.
The world may never know of their sacrifice, of the betrayal they faced, or of the celestial judgment that looms over them.
But they carry the lessons of this mission with them, a reminder that even in the darkest moments, honor and duty must guide their path.

And somewhere, far beyond the mortal realm, the Mortal King watches, waiting for the day when the balance of Seichi will be tested once more. The monarch is coming and this fragile peace will be broken.

objectives.description: The team departs the Global ANBU headquarters under the cover of night, each Chunin heading towards their assigned location. Their paths will take them through treacherous terrains
objectives.successDescription: Search the Area for the deity that is causing the disturbances.

objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.successDescription: The Misty Morass Awaits you.

objectives.description: The closer the team gets to unraveling the mystery, the more formidable their enemies become. The Mortal King’s servants, twisted reflections of celestial beings, emerge from the shadows. They are powerful foes—masters of forgotten jutsus, wielders of ancient weapons, and manipulators of dark chakra. Each battle is a test of not just skill but willpower, as the Chunin are forced to confront the very essence of fear and despair.  Yet, through it all, the Chunin fight on, driven by the knowledge that the fate of Seichi rests on their shoulders. They push their limits, discovering new strengths within themselves and forging unbreakable bonds with one another.
The wind spirit Yasei is here, defeat her and then head to the next location.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent
objectives.successDescription: Head To the Whirling Valley

objectives.description: The mission to uncover the Mortal King’s servants brings the Chunin to the Whirling Valley—a place as unforgiving as it is mysterious. Nestled between the Tornado Valley and Windswept Grasslands, the valley is infamous for its brutal winds and treacherous terrain. Yet, this harsh environment has become a refuge for those who serve the celestial figure, hiding in the chaos of the valley's ever-changing landscape.  The Chunin, tasked with tracking down these elusive servants, quickly realize that the Whirling Valley is unlike any other place they have encountered. The wind here is not just a force of nature; it is a barrier, a guardian of secrets. The valley’s relentless gales twist and turn, obscuring paths and covering tracks, making it nearly impossible to follow any conventional trail. The wind howls like a living creature, and the air is thick with the scent of danger.  Every step through the valley is a battle. The ground beneath their feet is unstable, shifting with the constant pressure of the wind. Loose rocks and sharp ridges make the terrain hazardous, and even the most skilled Shinobi must move with caution. objectives.description:
The journey of the Chunin has led them to an ancient ruin in the ironwood forest, a place forgotten by time and untouched by the living. The air is heavy with the presence of the celestial being known as the Mortal King. The ground beneath them hums with energy as they enter the final chamber, a vast space carved from stone and adorned with cryptic symbols that seem to shift and change with every glance. In the center of the chamber, a massive altar looms, pulsing with an otherworldly light. The Chunin can feel the power radiating from it, a force so overwhelming that it threatens to tear apart the fabric of reality itself. They know that this is where the Mortal King plans to unlock the Monarch Powers—a moment that could change the fate of Seichi forever. But as they prepare to confront the celestial being, something feels off. Haki, their enigmatic leader, stands before the altar, his back turned to them. His figure, usually so composed and commanding, now seems shrouded in a dark, almost malevolent energy. One of the Chunin speaks up, their voice laced with concern. "Haki, what are you doing? We need to stop the Mortal King!" Haki doesn't turn to face them. Instead, his voice echoes through the chamber, cold and detached.
"Stop him? No, I have no intention of stopping him. In fact, I have no intention of letting any of you leave this place alive."

The Chunin turn to face the celestial figure, who has remained silent until now. The Mortal King gazes at them with eyes that seem to hold the weight of countless stars. There is no anger in his expression, no malice—only a calm, almost serene acceptance of what has transpired. "I did not intervene because this was never about power," the Mortal King continues. "It was about judgment. You sought to claim what was not yours, Haki, and in doing so, you revealed the darkness within your heart. The Mortal King raises a hand, and for a moment, it seems as though he might unleash his celestial power upon them all. But instead, he simply turns away, his form beginning to dissolve into light. "The balance of Seichi will be restored," he says, his voice fading. "But remember this, mortals: true power lies not in strength or ambition, but in understanding the limits of one's own desires. I will be watching."

data.description:
"The Mortal King," Haki begins, his voice echoing in the stillness, "is no mere legend.
He is a celestial being whose presence alone disturbs the balance of our world.
He walks the line between divinity and mortality, wielding powers that can reshape the very fabric of Seichi."

He gestures toward a map spread across the table.
Marked upon it are several locations where traces of the Mortal King's presence have been detected—places where the laws of nature have been twisted, and chaos has ensued.
Wildfire erupts in the Shining Dunes without cause; eternal storms rage in Akikaze's Whirling Valley; ice forms in Hyorin's Frozen Highlands, not of Kuraokami's making, but of something far more sinister.

"Your mission is to track these disturbances," Haki continues, his eyes locking onto each Chunin in turn.
"Investigate the traces left behind by this celestial figure.
Find out what he seeks, and most importantly, prevent him from reaching the Monarch Powers—ancient forces that, if combined with his celestial abilities, could plunge our world into irreversible darkness."

The Chunin exchange glances, their resolve hardening.
Each of them carries the weight of their village on their shoulders, but none falter.
They understand the stakes—failure is not an option.

Haki pauses, allowing the gravity of his words to sink in.
Then, with a final nod, he concludes, "You will face not just the Mortal King, but those who serve him—beings of great power and deception.
Trust in your training, in each other, and in Seichi.
Dismissed."
data.successDescription:
They have won, but the victory is bittersweet.
Haki, once their leader, now lies defeated and broken.
The Monarch Powers remain beyond their reach, but Seichi is safe—for now.

As they make their way back to the surface, the Chunin know that their journey is far from over.
The world may never know of their sacrifice, of the betrayal they faced, or of the celestial judgment that looms over them.
But they carry the lessons of this mission with them, a reminder that even in the darkest moments, honor and duty must guide their path.

And somewhere, far beyond the mortal realm, the Mortal King watches, waiting for the day when the balance of Seichi will be tested once more. The monarch is coming and this fragile peace will be broken.

data.name: The Shattered Sakura: Part 1 - A Burdened Farewell
data.description: Whispers of a regional conflict between Shirohana and Akikaze have finally reached your ears, though the main villages seem largely unaffected. However, a small, independent nation, the Sakura Bloom Clan, has been caught in the crossfire. A somber request has arrived from Lord Kazuki: his daughter, Princess Yumi, must be escorted to safety near Hyorin. You are tasked with meeting her retainer, a seasoned Chunin, at a designated rendezvous point near the edge of the Misty Morass, and beginning the perilous journey. This mission is about protection, not glory.
data.successDescription: You successfully protected Princess Yumi and Takashi from desperate bandits, beginning the arduous escort mission. More importantly, you witnessed Princess Yumi's first fragile words, revealing the loss of her mother's cherished cherry blossom pin—a crucial step towards understanding her emotional pain and a potential turning point in her healing.

objectives.description: Travel to the rendezvous point (Edge of Misty Morass) in Sector 212

The air is thick with mist and the tension of waiting. Takashi, a Chunin with weary eyes, paces nervously, clutching a scroll. He turns sharply as you approach, then relaxes slightly, recognizing you.

"You are the shinobi sent by... good. There's no time for pleasantries. We've been through hell. Lord Kazuki sends his urgent plea for assistance. The Princess… she must be taken to safety. Here." (He thrusts the scroll into your hand.) "The war between Shirohana and Akikaze devastated our lands. Our village is a ruin. She's all that's left of our hope."
Collect Lord Kazuki's Letter

You receive Lord Kazuki's urgent letter. (Reading it: The letter details the destruction of the Sakura Bloom Clan's lands caught between the Shirohana-Akikaze conflict, and a rival clan, the Iron Claw, now threatens what little remains. Princess Yumi must be escorted to a sanctuary near Hyorin. Instructions are vague on the path, prioritizing speed and discretion.)

Takashi gestures to a small figure huddled beside a twisted tree. Princess Yumi, a young girl with disturbingly blank eyes, clutches a worn wooden doll. She doesn't look at you, her gaze fixed on the misty distance.
(Takashi speaks, his voice heavy with sorrow.) "Princess Yumi. She… she hasn’t spoken much since the raid. We need to move to the Abandoned Outpost in sector 261. It should be safer, for now."

nextObjectiveId.text: (Attempt to speak to Yumi gently.) "Hello, Princess. My name is..."

objectives.description: Escort Princess Yumi and Takashi to the Abandoned Outpost in sector 261. The journey is quiet, save for the rustling leaves and Yumi's faint footsteps.

You attempt to speak to Yumi, but she doesn't respond, her gaze unwavering, her grip on the doll tightening slightly. Takashi places a gentle hand on your shoulder. "She… she hasn’t responded since the last raid. She saw too much. Just focus on getting her to safety in sector. That's all that matters now."

(Takashi lets out a tired sigh.) "We are safe here for now. Lord Kazuki believes the Iron Claw Clan, a rival nation, is exploiting the chaos left by Shirohana and Akikaze to expand their influence. They would take Yumi to sever our line. He insists she go to Hyorin for now. It breaks his heart, but her safety is paramount. We need to reach the forest path soon, but something feels… off."

nextObjectiveId.text: We should rest briefly then move.

objectives.description: Suddenly, a branch snaps outside. Voices, coarse and cruel, can be heard approaching. "Heard rumors of a rich prize passing through this sector... might be that little princess."....  (Takashi's eyes widen in alarm.) "Bandits! They found us! Protect the Princess!"
Rogue Shinobi, desperate bandits, attack the outpost! Protect Princess Yumi and Takashi!
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to protect Princess Yumi and Takashi from the bandits. The mission is severely compromised.

objectives.description: With the bandits defeated, Takashi quickly checks on Yumi. She remains silent, but her body trembles. Takashi looks at you, grim. "Close call. These rogues are everywhere now, desperate after the war. This path is more dangerous than I thought. We need to move, now, and get to the Forest Path in sector 306. The sooner we reach safety, the better. No more delays."

nextObjectiveId.text: Agreed. Let's get to the Forest Path.
(Look at Yumi with concern.) "I think she needs comfort."

objectives.description: You continue the escort, moving carefully along the Forest Path. The dense canopy makes it hard to see, but also provides cover. Go to sector 306.

You glance at Yumi. She slowly, imperceptibly, reaches out a small hand and lightly grasps Takashi's sleeve. She still doesn't speak, but it's a small sign of connection. Takashi offers you a faint, grateful nod. "Even in silence, her spirit endures. She needs us now more than ever. We must protect that small ember."

You walk for some time in the quiet, shadowed forest. Suddenly, Yumi stops. She slowly reaches into her simple kimono and pulls out her wooden doll. Her eyes, still wide, finally seem to focus, not on you, but on the doll. A faint, almost lost whisper escapes her lips."...Mama... The cherry blossom… pin…"

(Takashi looks at you, surprised. This is the first she’s spoken.) "The cherry blossom pin? Her mother’s gift. She always wore it. It was lost during the raid, I think... It brought her comfort. It's a small, intricate pin, made of polished wood and silver, shaped like a blooming sakura, believed to have minor protective properties."

Princess Yumi has finally spoken, revealing her distress and the loss of a cherished, protective item—her mother's cherry blossom pin. This small connection to her past could be key to healing her spirit, but retrieving it means risking further danger.

nextObjectiveId.text: It must be important to her. We need to find it.
We don't have time to search. Her safety is more important.

data.name: The Shattered Sakura: Part 2 - Whispers of Home
data.description: Princess Yumi's whispered words revealed her longing for a lost cherry blossom pin: a memento of her mother and her shattered home. Against the original mission parameters, you and Takashi return to the Sakura Bloom ruins, where desperate survivors and Iron Claw scavengers haunt the echoes of war.
data.successDescription: You recovered Princess Yumi's Mother's Cherry Blossom Pin from the ruins and defeated the Iron Claw scavengers. Yumi's first fragile smile restored a small piece of hope, even as the escort toward Glacier—and harder choices—continues.

objectives.description:
You've made the decision to return for the pin. Takashi, though uneasy, nods in grim understanding. Princess Yumi looks up with a fleeting spark in her eyes.

Takashi lowers his voice. “The pin... a fragment of her mother's warmth. Expediency is one thing, but a broken spirit is another. The ruins of our home—Sector 87, coordinates 8,8—will be crawling with scavengers, perhaps even the Iron Claw. We must be swift. Princess, stay close. We go for your mother's memory.”
You begin the journey back to the Sakura Bloom Clan's ruined settlement. The air grows heavy with a sense of loss.

The devastation is worse than imagined. Buildings have become charcoal, the ground is scarred, and fresh tracks cross the snow.

Takashi clenches his fist. “Our home... This is what ‘victory’ looks like for the powerful. Desolation for the small. Yumi's mother often left sacred offerings at the Clan Shrine—Sector 88, coordinates 12,12. That's where we begin.”
You escort Yumi and Takashi through the ruins toward the damaged Clan Shrine. Only the wind disturbs the silence.

A gaunt survivor claws through the overturned offering box. She recoils when she sees you.

Ryoko's voice trembles. “Please! Don't hurt me! I'm just looking for food... or anything. They took everything. The Iron Claw come and go, taking what's left.” Her eyes find Yumi. “Princess Yumi? You're... alive?”

nextObjectiveId.text: Takashi comforts Ryoko. “We need the Princess's pin. Did you see it?”
Focus on the mission. “Have you seen a small cherry blossom pin?”

objectives.description: Tears gather in Ryoko's hollow eyes. “The pin... no. But the Iron Claw scavengers went through the barracks—Sector 89, coordinates 5,10. They take anything shiny. Sometimes they fight among themselves over trinkets. It may be there... if they haven't destroyed it.”
You leave Ryoko and advance toward the ruined barracks, her warning about Iron Claw scavengers ringing in your ears.

Broken weapons and empty crates cover the barracks floor. Rough voices carry from the next room. “This scrap isn't worth much. But the other fellow had a fancy pin—said it glowed. Wonder where he stashed it.”

Takashi whispers fiercely, “Iron Claw. They're still here, and they have the pin. Princess, stay behind me.”
Defeat all three Iron Claw Scavengers and recover Mother's Cherry Blossom Pin.

objectives.successDescription: The pin's warmth steadies in your hand as though recognizing Yumi nearby.

objectives.description:
Takashi cleans the pin with trembling hands and places it in Yumi's palm. A tiny, fragile smile touches her lips.

“Mama...” Yumi whispers, clutching the pin. “It's warm.” She looks at you with genuine gratitude.

Takashi clears his throat. “She remembers. Thank you, shinobi. This is more than a pin. It's a flicker of hope. But the Iron Claw will return. Dawn approaches; we head toward Glacier as planned.”

nextObjectiveId.text: Her smile is worth it. Let's go.

The pale dawn illuminates the forest path. Takashi looks at you with profound gratitude. “You risked much for her small hope. This is what true protection means. We continue toward the safety Lord Kazuki insists upon. But her words, her smile... they stir something in me. For now, we follow orders. This journey is far from over.”

data.name: The Shattered Sakura: Part 3 - A Crossroads of Duty
data.description: Near Glacier's supposed safety, news arrives that the Iron Claw Clan is annihilating the Sakura Bloom survivors. Choose between the duty of protecting Princess Yumi and the desperate hope of returning her to her people.
data.successDescription: At the crossroads between obligation and hope, your choice determined both Princess Yumi's future and the legacy of the shattered Sakura Bloom Clan.

objectives.description:
Temporary Refuge — Forest Cave

Takashi, voice low: "We are nearing Glacier's outer patrols. Safety is almost within reach. Yumi has been speaking more, hasn't she? About our village. About the others. She carries such a heavy burden for one so young. Her father's orders are clear, but..."

He trails off. Princess Yumi sits beside the meager fire, clutching her mother's pin while its faint light trembles across the cave walls.

Temporary Refuge — Forest Cave

Princess Yumi looks up, her eyes no longer empty but burning with quiet resolve.

"I cannot abandon them. Our people… they suffer. Father made me leave for my protection, but what of their protection? The Iron Claw attacks. I carry Mama's pin now. It feels warm. It feels like strength. I must help them."

Takashi's jaw tightens. "Her spirit is strong. But her safety… that is our mission."

nextObjectiveId.text: We need more information before any decision.

objectives.description: Seek Kiyoshi at the Glacier scout rendezvous beside the frozen river.

Scout's Camp — Makeshift

Kiyoshi studies you over a frostglass map. "You're the escort. Good. The Iron Claw have begun a full-scale assault on the remaining Sakura Bloom settlements. Lord Genzo himself leads the charge. They intend to erase the clan and claim its ancestral lands."

Takashi pales. Yumi's grief flashes into fierce determination. "My people… under siege. I have to go back!"

Kiyoshi offers an ice-forged device. "This is a Glacier Rescue Beacon. Glacier is two days ahead. Your home is one hard day behind you. Duty, or a desperate hope—the choice is yours."

nextObjectiveId.text: I understand. Give me the beacon.

objectives.description: Receive Kiyoshi's single-use Glacier Rescue Beacon.

Scout's Camp — Makeshift

Yumi clasps her glowing pin. "Please! They are my people. Mama's spirit protects them too. I will not be safe knowing they are lost. Please—help me save them!"

Takashi stares into the fire. "My orders are to ensure her safety. But her spirit is undeniable. What say you, shinobi? Do we fulfill our oath and continue to Glacier, or turn back toward a battle we may not survive?"

nextObjectiveId.text: We continue to Glacier. Her safety is paramount.
We turn back. We will help save her clan.

objectives.description: Continue through Glacier's windswept outer pass. Yumi walks in heartbroken silence.

Glacier Outer Territory — Snowy Pass

Takashi's voice is nearly lost beneath the wind. "We chose safety. It was the order. But what price does that safety carry? A princess without a people. I pray Lord Kazuki understands."
Reach Glacier Village's grand ice-and-stone entrance.

Glacier Village Main Entrance

Takashi turns to you with relief and profound sorrow. Yumi stands beside him, distant and silent.

"We fulfilled the mission. She is safe. You have done your duty, shinobi. But the weight of this silence echoes with the cries we left behind. This is safety—but is it salvation? I do not know."
Duty ending: Princess Yumi reaches Glacier alive, but the fate of her people remains uncertain.
objectives.successDescription: You secured the Sakura Bloom bloodline through stern obligation, though the cries left behind will follow you.

objectives.description: Turn back toward Sakura territory. In the narrow gorge, movement above signals an ambush.

Ambush Site — Narrow Gorge

A chilling laugh descends from the ice walls. Lord Genzo drops into the gorge with three elite guards.

"Well, well. The little blossom princess running back to her rotting roots—and foolish shinobi leading her to her doom. That pin will be mine. Then your clan will finally disappear."

Ambush Site — Narrow Gorge

The beacon ignites. A thin spear of blue chakra climbs into the storm.

Genzo laughs. "A tiny flare in this vastness? Help will arrive in time to bury you. Finish them!"
The three Iron Claw Elite Guards attack in a coordinated first wave. Break their formation and protect Yumi.
objectives.drawDescription: The frozen gorge swallows both formations in a bitter stalemate.
objectives.failDescription: The elite formation overwhelms your defense and closes upon Yumi.
objectives.fleeDescription: You abandon the gorge while the Iron Claw closes on Yumi.

objectives.description: With his guards broken, Lord Genzo enters the battle himself. Defeat the Iron Claw leader.
objectives.drawDescription: Genzo falls to one knee, but so do you; neither side can claim victory.
objectives.failDescription: Genzo's earth and wind techniques crush the last line protecting Yumi.
objectives.fleeDescription: You flee the gorge, leaving Sakura's last hope behind.

objectives.description:
Ambush Site — Narrow Gorge

Genzo's weapon falls into the snow. Yumi rushes to Takashi, then faces you through tears.

"We did it! We fought for them. Thank you, shinobi—thank you!"

Takashi leans on his sword. "You chose the harder path—the path of hope. But we must reach the survivors at the ruined outskirts. Your strength has given them a chance."
Press onward to the besieged Sakura Bloom Clan outskirts and rally the survivors.

Sakura Bloom Clan Outskirts — Under Siege

Smoke rolls across burning barricades. Then Princess Yumi steps forward, her mother's pin shining against the ruin.

"My people! Lord Genzo is defeated! We will not fall. We will rebuild!"

Takashi raises his sword. "Help is on the way! We fight for the Princess! We fight for the Sakura Bloom Clan!"

The exhausted survivors rise. Despair becomes defiance.
Hope ending: Genzo is defeated and Princess Yumi transforms the survivors' despair into defiance.

data.name: The Silent Bloom
data.description: The secluded village of Verdant Hollow is afflicted by the "Ashen Slumber," a mysterious condition where villagers fall into a deep, unwaking sleep. As a medical specialist, you must use your diagnostic and analytical skills to investigate the cause, deduce the necessary components for a cure, and synthesize an elixir before the slumber becomes permanent.
data.successDescription: The elixir works. A wave of gentle energy washes over the village, and the sleeping residents begin to stir, awakening as if from a long dream. Your medical expertise and sharp investigative mind have saved Verdant Hollow.

objectives.description: Our people are falling into the Ashen Slumber. Our healers are baffled. Please, use your skills to diagnose this illness and find a cure. The fate of our village is in your hands.

Your diagnostic jutsu reveals no cellular decay from poison and no residual energy from genjutsu. The patients' life signs are stable but incredibly slow, as if their entire metabolism has been put on hold. What is your primary diagnosis?
Stasis? A forced hibernation? The only recent change was a strong northern wind carrying a sweet scent. The water tastes the same, the ground is unchanged. What is your next investigative step?
Based on your deduction, you travel to the Whispering Canyon to find the source of the airborne agent.
The canyon is filled with a fine, grey pollen. A Spore-Infused Boar, made aggressive by the spores, charges at you
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: You find the source: a pale, shade-loving flower, the Ashen Lotus. You carefully collect a sample of its potent pollen.
You analyze the pollen. It induces a state of extreme lethargy by calming chakra to a near-standstill. To create an antidote, you must reverse this process. What is the correct medical strategy?

To counteract the calming effect, you need a natural ingredient with intensely stimulating properties, likely one that thrives in a high-energy environment. Your map shows a location that fits the criteria: the Sunstone Mesa.
On the sun-baked surface of the mesa, you find a patch of vibrant ferns that seem to glow with absorbed sunlight.

You now have two highly reactive, opposing ingredients. Combining them directly will result in a volatile, uncontrolled energy release. What is the correct synthesis process to create a stable elixir?
You deduce that you need a pure, liquid medium. Elder Kaelen mentioned a sacred spring blessed by the village's founder. Travel there.

You have all three components. Following your deductions, you use the pure water as a medium to balance the two opposing ingredients. The mixture stabilizes, glowing with a warm, golden light. You have successfully crafted Anya's Wakefulness Elixir.

nextObjectiveId.text: Return to Verdant Hollow to administer the cure

objectives.description: Return to Verdant Hollow to administer the cure.

You administer the elixir. A golden light spreads from person to person, and slowly, the villagers begin to awaken. Elder Kaelen weeps with joy. "Your skill is beyond anything I have ever seen. You have saved us all."
Your deduction was flawed. Unable to correctly identify the cause or the necessary components, you cannot create the cure. The Ashen Slumber remains, and the village is lost to its silent fate.

data.name: The Silken Thread Unravels
data.description: The Crystal Weaver has been defeated and peace is restored to  Yukigumo Village. Or so you think. A message comes for you in the middle of the night, a taunt and an invitation both. Will you answer the call?
data.successDescription: You have won after a long struggle. You’ve fought for peace and saved the lives of Yukigumo village’s citizens. But still… a haunting chill lingers in the wind.

objectives.description: A letter has arrived for you from Yukigumo Village. Meanwhile, the disappearances have escalated since then. Head out at once and investigate what’s happening.

The letter is heavy, made with fine parchment. It shines in the light with silvery lines that look somewhat like snowflakes. Breaking the seal, you read the contents of the letter.  "You have fought bravely, and our people are free thanks to you. Come—join us for a feast in your honor, so we may celebrate the peace you’ve given us."
You return to the snowbound village where the cult was last seen. Following the letter’s directions, you arrive at a grand hall ablaze with lantern light.

Inside, a long banquet table stretches across the chamber, filled with smiling guests. Whispers ripple among them—you hear that each has received a letter, just like yours. Tonight is meant to celebrate peace, and you are the guest of honor. Do you take your place at the table or mingle with the guests more?

You wander among the guests, exchanging pleasantries while watching the food being served. From your vantage, you notice something strange: the servers bear pale, glimmering tattoos on their wrists. In the lanternlight, you can’t tell whether they’re meant to be snowflakes… or spiderwebs.  Before you can decide to approach one, a bell is chimed clearly indicating that the banquet has begun.

You lose yourself in the celebration. The tables are heaped with roasted wildfowl, platters of steaming vegetables, tender cuts of meat stacked high, and fruit so ripe it glistens. Goblets of spiced wine and mulled rum never seem to empty.   But as the night wears on, your body grows heavy. Your eyes droop, the warmth fades, and a biting chill seeps in.

You stealthily try to follow one of the servers as he makes his way towards the back. He turns towards a hallway and as you follow, you accidentally step on a trip wire.  He spins around with eerie grace and you hear an inhuman hiss

data.name: The Tale of Goah Way: The Encounter on the Forest Trail
data.description: While traveling with the wandering sun praiser, Goah Way, you discover an unconscious ninja from the Village of Silence. He's alive, but his story about being ambushed by a deer seems... odd. Goah intends to help, but the decision to get involved rests with you.
data.successDescription: You helped Goah get the injured ninja, Sigi, to safety. After his recovery, you learned the slightly embarrassing truth of his accident and forged an unexpected but valuable alliance with a shinobi from the Village of Freedom State.

data.name: The Tale of Goah Way: The Girl Who Carried Two Storms
data.description: Goah Way follows whispers of black lightning and two women speaking through an impossible storm. At an abandoned watchtower he finds a girl carrying Eclipse's obsidian chakra and Aegis's violet lightning. Together they confront the surviving Unbroken Thread.
data.successDescription: The ancient vault is destroyed. The Unbroken Thread is broken. The girl who carried two storms chooses what her legacy will mean.

objectives.description: Rain falls beneath a clear sky. Merchants whisper of black lightning, ancient bones, and two women speaking through the storm. Goah Way adjusts his weathered pack and walks toward the eastern pass.
Reach Stormbreak Pass, where lightning crawls beneath the mountain.
A shattered watchtower overlooks the valley. A woman steps into the rain with obsidian chakra on one side of her body and violet lightning on the other. She says only: Leave.

nextObjectiveId.text: I am here because everyone calls you a monster.
I will not draw a weapon unless you do.

objectives.description: She asks whether Goah came to kill her. He sees the patched roof, the struggling garden, and a life built from hiding. Goah answers that he came to ask her name.
During a night of thunder, she speaks of Eclipse, whose chakra devoured light, and Aegis, who carried the voice of a dying storm god. Their final words were: Live for us. Carry the sky.

nextObjectiveId.text: Honor the women who came before her.

objectives.description: The woman remembers almost nothing of her childhood. Goah tells her that memory is not a prison unless frightened people build its walls.
The Unbroken Thread survived beneath the mountains. Its scavengers and zealots have found the heir carrying both bloodlines. Their ritual needs a living key.

nextObjectiveId.text: Stand beside her when the cult arrives.

objectives.description: The Unbroken Thread emerges from the rain wearing the faces of ordinary travelers. Their seals ignite around the watchtower.
objectives.drawDescription: The mountain refuses to name a victor.
objectives.failDescription: Defeat sends the storm-carrier back into the rain before the cult can be stopped.
objectives.fleeDescription: The trail disappears into thunder and black mist.

objectives.description: The cult drives Goah and the storm-carrier away from the watchtower. The rain gives them one more chance.
The cultists fall, but the mountain answers with a mechanical groan. The woman looks toward an ancient vault and says the ritual is already waking beneath the earth.

nextObjectiveId.text: Follow the trail into the hollow.

objectives.description: Enter the Rain Hollow and find the concealed vault entrance.
An ancient ritual guardian awakens as obsidian and violet chakra overlap at the vault door.
objectives.drawDescription: The mountain refuses to name a victor.
objectives.failDescription: Defeat sends the storm-carrier back into the rain before the cult can be stopped.
objectives.fleeDescription: The trail disappears into thunder and black mist.

objectives.description: The guardian forces the pair back through the rain. Return to the vault entrance before the old machine seals itself.

Inside the vault, the woman touches a broken pendant. Memory floods the chamber: Eclipse shielding her with bone, Aegis carrying lightning in both hands, and two sisters choosing protection over vengeance.

nextObjectiveId.text: Carry their promise into the machine core.

objectives.description: Reach the Machine Core Chamber before High Inquisitor Varos completes the extraction seal.
High Inquisitor Varos begins harvesting the inherited bloodlines. The storm-carrier steps forward, no longer asking permission to exist.
objectives.drawDescription: The mountain refuses to name a victor.
objectives.failDescription: Defeat sends the storm-carrier back into the rain before the cult can be stopped.
objectives.fleeDescription: The trail disappears into thunder and black mist.

objectives.description: Varos forces the group away from the machine core. The extraction seal is not complete yet.
Varos calls her stolen blood. Goah calls her a person. She looks at lightning in one hand and black chakra in the other. For the first time, the choice is hers.

nextObjectiveId.text: I will carry both storms—and give them my own name.
The past belongs to me now.

objectives.description: The vault collapses beneath the mountain. The Unbroken Thread vanishes into the storm it tried to command. Goah remembers only the girl who carried two storms and refused to let either be forgotten.
objectives.successDescription: The storm-carrier chooses her own name, and the sisters' legacy becomes a promise instead of a prison.

data.name: The Tower of Endless Night: Dawnless Crown
data.description: At the Tower's summit waits the Unbroken Thread's masterwork: the machine built to fuse two stolen bloodlines into one, still hungry, still unfinished. Five battles per floor. Take your accumulated winnings and leave early, or climb to the throne. Lose anywhere and you leave with nothing. Cast down The Endless Night for the climb's fortune.

data.name: The Wyrmspire Nest
data.description: Livestock and travelers have vanished along the mountain roads. Scouts traced wing-shadows to an obsidian spire riddled with nesting tunnels. Destroy the brood before the clutch hatches and the skies belong to dragons.

objectives.successDescription: You finally see it. The entrance yawning before you, black as the void and rimmed with frost. The Spider’s lair… hidden so close all this time. How many vanished souls found this same descent before you? You steel yourself and step into the dark below.

objectives.description: The tunnel opens into a vast cavern bathed in faint, shimmering light. A bed of pale blue flowers glows on the stone floor, life blooming where it shouldn’t. Faint daylight filters through a crack far above, glinting on the ice. Two tunnels lie ahead, each swallowing the light whole.
It feels like the path you’ve taken has doubled back on itself.

You press on, the passage narrowing until you must stoop to pass. The cold burns your lungs. When it finally widens, you find yourself before a ring of faintly glowing mushrooms, their light breathing softly against the stone. Ahead, three openings wait, black and hungry.
It feels like the path you’ve taken has doubled back on itself.

You follow the tunnel, its twists and turns leading you steadily upward. At last, a sharp crack of light greets you. You push through loose stone and ice, only to emerge once more into the frozen surface above. The storm greets you like an old friend. You’ve circled back.

nextObjectiveId.text: Descend into the tunnels once more.

objectives.description: It feels like the path you’ve taken has doubled back on itself.

This path feels older than the rest. The walls are scarred, clawed, and pitted. In the next cavern, a lone skeleton sits frozen against the wall, its armor shattered, its sword still clutched tight. The air feels colder here, heavier with memory.
It feels like the path you’ve taken has doubled back on itself.

A faint trickle of water echoes ahead. You come to a shallow stream running through the tunnel, clear and impossibly cold. Tiny shards of ice drift lazily across its surface. On the far side, three more paths wait, half-shrouded in mist.
It feels like the path you’ve taken has doubled back on itself.
It feels like the path you’ve taken has doubled back on itself.

The cold sharpens as you descend deeper. Your breath hangs heavy in the air. Strands of web begin to glisten along the stone walls, delicate and quivering. The silence grows unbearable. You can feel it, something vast and patient is near. Ahead, three paths yawn open.
It feels like the path you’ve taken has doubled back on itself.
It feels like the path you’ve taken has doubled back on itself.

You press forward, and the tunnel begins to spiral. The web grows thicker until it coats every surfac, walls, ceiling, floor, muffling even your breath. The air grows close, suffocating, heavy with dread. Somewhere ahead, something skitters, slow and deliberate. The passage widens into a cavern veiled in silk.

The cavern is immense. Sheets of silk hang from the ceiling like tattered banners, swaying in a chill current that shouldn’t exist. Faint blue light pulses through veins of chakra that weave across the floor, forming a living web beneath your feet. Between the curtains of silk, a shadow stirs, massive, graceful, deliberate.  Then comes her voice: ancient and rasping, like winter wind whispering through a graveyard of ice. A soft, humorless titter echoes, followed by words that coil through the dark.

The silk stirs. From the shadowed ceiling, she descends—an enormous arachne, her upper body crowned in bone-white armor, her eyes gleaming with cold intelligence. The lower half of her body gleams with frostbitten chitin, her legs clicking against the web-strung stone.  Her laughter fractures the silence.
Naughty little youngling... you’ve slaughtered my children, trespassed in my sanctum. But this, this is where you meet your end.

The left tunnel slopes down gently, the air growing heavy and still. You find a small underground pond, its surface frozen smooth as glass. The silence here is absolute, no movement, no life. Whatever dwelled here is long gone.

data.description: An hour before dawn a witness has to reach a hearing on the other side of the village, and the people who want her absent were paid to take her alive. Three ways across. All of them end in a fight.
data.successDescription: She reached the steps and she gave the name.

objectives.description:
The handler does not sit down, and does not offer you tea. She lays a folded contract on the table and turns it so the price faces you.

"Somebody bought her. Not her death, her absence. Take, was the word they used."

nextObjectiveId.text: Absence buys silence. Death buys questions.

objectives.description:
She does not agree out loud. She taps the table twice with one finger, the way you tap a wall in the dark to find the door.

"The last one I sent asked me why they had not simply killed her. Since you are quicker than him, keep up. The Unsigned chalk a lane before they work it, one stroke, low on the corner stone. Not a warning to you. A note they leave each other."

nextObjectiveId.text: Then I will read their notes.

objectives.description:
She looks up properly for the first time, and does not quite hide that she is reassessing you.

"Slowly, then. A body is a crime. Somebody has to investigate a crime, and investigating this one means reading the ledger she was going to talk about. A witness who simply fails to arrive is nobody's case at all. Now, the Unsigned chalk a lane before they work it. One stroke, low on the corner stone. It is not a warning meant for you, it is a note they leave each other."

nextObjectiveId.text: Then I will read their notes.

objectives.description:
Kanna is twenty two, has not slept, and holds a rolled statement against her chest like it is the only warm thing she owns.

"They came to my father's house first," she says. "They were very polite about it. That is the part I keep thinking about."

She is at the door with her coat already on, standing at your left shoulder like she was told. Past it the village is dark for another hour, and somewhere in that hour people are standing very still, waiting to be told which way the two of you went.

"You choose," she says. "I have been choosing all week and look where it put me."

nextObjectiveId.text: The market road. Loud rooms hide loud men.
The back lanes. Slow, blind, ours.
Give me your coat. You walk alone.

objectives.description: The market road is loud with carts before dawn, which is cover of a kind, and a hundred witnesses, which is not.

A fruit seller looks at you twice and then does not look at all. Two men come through the crowd at walking pace, because hurrying is what a crowd remembers.

"The polite one is on the left," Kanna says. Her voice does not shake, which is somehow worse.
Two of them working the crowd. Neither one looks at Kanna, which means each is counting on the other to reach her first.

objectives.successDescription: The crowd closes over it before it has finished happening. She has not moved from behind your shoulder.

objectives.description: The back lanes take three times as long and cross no open ground at all. A patrol passes the lane mouth and you wait it out with her hand over her own mouth.

Chalk on the corner stone. One stroke, low down, unweathered. The rain stopped two hours ago.

"It is only chalk," Kanna whispers. "Children do that."

nextObjectiveId.text: Children do not chalk at midnight. Take the parallel.

objectives.description:
You take the parallel and leave theirs empty. Somewhere behind you a lane that somebody spent the evening preparing stays quiet all the way to dawn, and nobody standing in it ever learns why.

"Children," Kanna says, eventually. "Yes. That was stupid of me."
Not children. The lane was chalked because it is long, and blind, and opens at one end, and what is waiting at that end has been waiting a while.

objectives.description:
The coat is tight across your shoulders and smells of her house. She takes the servants' stair without being told twice.

"If they take you instead of me," she says from the dark, "I am still going. I wanted you to know that first."
They send the good one after the coat. She works out that it is empty about four steps too late, and does not stop, because she was not paid to stop.

objectives.successDescription: The coat is ruined. Kanna is three streets away and has not been touched.

objectives.description: The hearing hall stands at the top of eleven steps. The bell has not rung.

Someone has been sitting on the steps long enough that the frost has taken the shape of him. He stands at the exact distance where leaving stops being something you can do quietly.

"She has an hour," he says. "I only need her to miss it."

nextObjectiveId.text: Then you come through me first.

objectives.description: He takes you up on it without a word. No lane, no crowd, no coat. Eleven steps, and a bell about to ring.

objectives.successDescription: The bell rings on the second stroke of it. She walks up past you and does not look down.

objectives.description:
The clerk checks the hour before he checks her name, and writes them down in that order.

"If she had come in after the bell," he says, still writing, "I would have noted that instead, and there would be nothing here to hear. No crime in it. The record does not ask why a person was late."

nextObjectiveId.text: One hour. That was the whole price of her.

objectives.description: Witness delivered, statement taken.

You come to in a doorway with your collar gone stiff. Two doors down, behind the water butt, something that has been holding still for twenty minutes moves.

"I did what you told me," Kanna says. "The bell has not rung yet. Get up."
The safehouse, the lamp oil, the three ways across the village.

data.description:
Freedom State doesn’t sleep.



By dawn, the lanterns still burn green, their glow staining the sky. The once-lively market streets are quiet — masks abandoned, music silenced, and offerings left to smolder in their trays.



Before noon, messengers arrive with grim news: the corruption has spread. Every village that lit Veilnight lanterns reports the same eerie transformation — their flames turned green, their nights filled with distant laughter.



This isn’t a local disturbance.


It’s an echo moving through all of Seichi.



“If his influence is riding the light,” someone says, “then every lantern we kindled last night opened a door.”



Your Momo follows silently now, her energy unstable, the green flicker still buried behind her eyes. She flinches at each whisper of laughter that drifts in on the wind.
data.successDescription:
Each victory quiets the laughter only for a moment. Every village’s lantern burns green again before dimming — sending a pulse of light back toward Freedom State.
When the final echo fades, it’s clear where all of this leads.
The heart of the disturbance has never left the Lantern of Balance.
Grimjack (distant): “The farther you run, the closer you are.”

By nightfall, the lantern in Freedom State blazes brighter than ever, green fire clawing at the sky.
